description: Historische bodemdaling door veenoxidatie is a dataset listed in National Georegister of the Netherlands, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by download.geodata-utrecht.nl. Picture of the historical fall in soil due to peat oxidation in the province of Utrecht in m/yr. based on the altitude data collected in the years between 1955 and 1975 by the Measurement Service of Rijkswaterstaat (MD) and the altitude data (5X5m) from the Current Height File Netherlands 2 (AHN2), also from Rijkswaterstaat. Coverage: NL. The portal shows the English title as "Historical subsidence due to peat oxidation" (machine-translated by the portal). The listing shows 2022-03-29 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-ngr-nl.
